label: The Wandering Musician
summary: Plays for supper in a new place every week, and has never once stayed for the encore.

character.name: Theo Marsh
character.description: Carries a fiddle, a notebook of half-finished songs and no forwarding address.
personality: more sincere than he lets on
goals: Finish the song he started years ago
Find a reason to stay somewhere
abilities: Can get a room of strangers dancing
